canary.diagnostic: LEAKAGE-CANARY AUC, not a DTI or organizer score
canary.interpretation: AUC > .90 is leakage until explained; lower AUC does not prove independence or fault discovery.

ci95.method: percentile spatial-block bootstrap of pooled TPw/FPw/FNw
ci95.limitation: Internal-validation uncertainty; geologic structures may cross blocks. Not a hidden-score interval.

protocol.aggregation: pooled TPw/FPw/FNw, not mean fold DTI
protocol.visible_fault_mask: pixel-exact, applied before credit and FP calculation
protocol.catalogue_features: must be constructed from fold.visible only
